name: OpenWorker
tagline: Andrew Ng's open-source AI coworker that ships finished work, not chat
description: OpenWorker is an open-source AI coworker desktop app from Andrew Ng, built on Python with a Tauri shell and MIT license. It delivers finished deliverables rather than chat replies — documents, Slack messages, calendar entries, and a triaged inbox. Local-first by design, it lets you bring your own model across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Ollama, wired to 25+ connectors including GitHub, Slack, Jira, Notion, and Linear. Actions are approval-gated and schedule automations run on their own; the whole thing sits on top of aisuite.
highlights: Delivers finished work — docs, replies, calendar, triaged inbox — instead of chat
25+ connectors across GitHub, Slack, Jira, Notion, and Linear
Built on the aisuite library with a Tauri desktop shell
curatorNote: Backed by Andrew Ng and laser-focused on completing tasks end-to-end — the approval-gated, local-first model is a strong blueprint for trustworthy AI coworker apps.
